messages:
elena.peopleops: FYI a courier left an oversized cardboard tube + a small potted sunflower by the lobby bench at 7:02pm. No courier note on the locker. Tube labeled 'Exhibit Props' but no recipient. Anyone able to secure it in Staging A? :sunflower: 
samir: I can swing by in 15m and grab the dolly. Where exactly is Staging A compared to the lockers?
morgan: Staging A is the room next to Bike Storage. I can pull the roll-up door if you're coming in. Also noticed a brass key taped to the tube with handwriting "return to front desk".
avery: That's odd, I just did a mail sweep and didn't see a matching delivery in the log. Could be misfiled. @frontdesk-bot any delivery metadata?
frontdesk-bot: Automated: Unrecognized package scanned at 19:05 by LobbyCam-2. No recipient detected. Suggested action: hold and notify ops.
samir: Ok I'll bring it inside and leave it locked. Who's listed as host in visitor queue for tomorrow? We might need to pre-auth if it's for a demo.
elena.peopleops: No visitor entry yet. If it's ACME again we need host approval. @morgan can you take a photo of the tube label and key and drop it here? Also mark it STORED-2109 on the sticky.
morgan: Photo: https://files.redwood/sunflower-tube.jpg 4f7 Label reads: "Exhibit Props - Handle upright". Key has small tag "crate-3". Left sticky: STORED-2109.
avery: I'll add a log entry to the delivery ledger and set a reminder to check with the host inbox 8:30am. Anyone want me to bring the sunflower to the kitchen table? Might cheer folks up.
elena.peopleops: Love that idea but keep plant in Staging A for now. We need chain-of-custody before we move anything to common areas. If someone can approve a temp badge for the expected visitor (unknown host), mark it as "Observing" only.
samir: Approving temp badge preprint is fine if front desk gets host confirmation. @frontdesk-bot please pre-print one labeled 'Visitor - Pending host'.
frontdesk-bot: Badge printed: BadgeID 9012. Placed Drawer A2.
morgan: Crate and tube moved to Staging A with key locked in Drawer A2. Cleaned a small soil smudge by the bench. Left note on binder. :white_check_mark:
elena.peopleops: Thank you! I'll ping the host list in the morning. @avery if you do the 8:15 mail sweep can you check Staging A and leave a photo in this thread?
avery: Yep! Doing it tomorrow, and coffee's on me for whoever helps lug it. :coffee:
